premise: Actual acquired and paid Polymorph R4 Humanoid is already operative before Unholy Ascendance. The original gear is melded; T transfers a real focus into A's custody before the UA cast.
assertions: UA activation does not reset or replace Polymorph concentration/deadline.
Actual Antimagic Field suppresses both transformations; exit resumes only surviving records with unchanged clocks.
Current Dispel Magic is rank3, can end only rank0-3 effects, and has no automatic upcast; the attempted early removal is rejected before cost/action.
Polymorph expires at its own deadline while UA remains; the original body/gear return without refreshing UA, which later expires at its own deadline.
Living-only Healing Rite is legal on the same character after natural reversion; no early-UA-dismissal witness is claimed because no eligible source remover is currently bounded.
